subject: GCP marketplace listing: orchestration & procurement punchlist
messages:
From: Maria Torres <maria.torres@gcp-partners.google.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood + HelioMed: GCP listing intake and procurement artifacts

Hi Irene / team,

Great to connect — following our intake call I wanted to summarize the minimal items required by the Partner Onboarding team so HelioMed can appear in the GCP Marketplace and qualify for co-sell: 

- Signed Partner Registration (we have the template attached).
- SKU mapping spreadsheet with SKU IDs, pricing model (BYOL, metered), and product->GCP SKU mapping — required for billing sync.
- Procurement contact + PO cadence (the buyer at HelioMed has requested a 30-day review period).
- DocuSign executed contract or marketplace terms URL.
- Security attestation: SOC2 Type II date and retention policy (we can accept a pointer to Redwood’s SOC2 report).

I attached the Redwood intake PDF and the Partner onboarding checklist. Next steps I propose: Redwood provides SKU mapping + procurement punchlist by Wednesday 12/1; GCP partner ops will open the listing ticket and confirm partner ID.

Can you confirm who will own the SKU mapping and whether HelioMed needs an invoice-based flow or co-sell SPM routing?

Thanks,
Maria

--
Maria Torres
Partner Ecosystem, GCP Marketplace
Google Cloud Partners

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Torres <maria.torres@gcp-partners.google.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood + HelioMed: GCP listing intake and procurement artifacts

Maria — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming Redwood will own the SKU mapping and procurement punchlist; we will deliver the artifacts and the signed partner registration. Quick answers to your questions: 

- Owner: Karthik will own SKU mapping and billing model (cc’d).
- Procurement flow: HelioMed prefers invoice-based procurement but wants co-sell routing when possible. We’ll surface both options on the punchlist so GCP knows the preferred routing and backup fallback.
- Security: attaching pointer to SOC2 and retention notes in the punchlist.

Deliverables and timeline: 
1) SKU mapping spreadsheet (draft) — Karthik by Tue 11/30 EOD.
2) Procurement punchlist (doc with DocuSign link, buyer contact, PO cadence) — Vanessa by Wed 12/1 noon.
3) Completed intake package + signed partner reg — me by Wed 12/1 EOD.

I’m attaching the intake PDF and the punchlist draft (placeholder) to kick off. If GCP needs anything else for co-sell enablement (SPM mapping keys, partner ID), flag it and I’ll escalate.

Best,
Irene

Irene Choi
Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 08:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Procurement punchlist draft for HelioMed (attach)

Irene / Karthik — attaching the procurement-punchlist-v1.docx — main callouts:

- Buyer contact: procurement@heliomed.com (PO review window: 30 calendar days).
- Contracting: HelioMed requires a standard marketplace order form + DS signature on the MSA (they will not sign custom terms).
- Billing: prefer invoice with net 30, but will accept GCP invoicing if co-sell route used. We need to map Redwood SKU IDs to GCP SKUs and confirm whether metered pricing will map cleanly to HelioMed’s usage tiers.
- Compliance: SOC2 link + data retention clause — acceptable as-is.

Action items:
- Karthik: populate sku-mapping-template.xlsx with Redwood SKU IDs and pricing model by EOD Tue 11/30.
- Marcus: validate SKU tax codes for US regions (cc’d).
- Irene: finalize partner reg and send to Maria for intake by 12/1 EOD.

Minor note: I put a sticky item in JIRA (INF-4821) to track the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks — V.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 17:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Procurement punchlist draft for HelioMed (attach)

On Tue, Nov 30, 2027 at 08:27 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Irene / Karthik — attaching the procurement-punchlist-v1.docx — main callouts:
> 
> - Buyer contact: procurement@heliomed.com (PO review window: 30 calendar days).
> - Contracting: HelioMed requires a standard marketplace order form + DS signature on the MSA (they will not sign custom terms).

Thanks — I’ll take the SKU mapping. Draft attached (sku-mapping-template.xlsx) with the first tranche of SKUs and suggested pricing tiers. Notes:
- Two SKUs are metered (token-based) and will need quota/usage descriptor for GCP.
- For co-sell routing, mark those two SKUs as "co-sell-eligible" in column H so GCP can wire SPM tags.

I’ll finish the remaining SKUs tomorrow morning and push to the shared Drive folder listed in the intake doc. Marcus — can you check tax/tariff codes when you get a chance?

Karthik

Karthik Iyer
Product Ops (Billing & Marketplace)
Redwood Inference

From: Maria Torres <maria.torres@gcp-partners.google.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement@heliomed.com
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 16:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood + HelioMed: GCP listing intake and procurement artifacts

Thanks everyone — partner intake ticket INF-4821 is created and assigned to partner-ops. I see the SKU mapping draft and the punchlist; partner-ops will validate SKU IDs and confirm the GCP SKU equivalents by Friday 12/3.

Next steps:
- GCP will open a co-sell routing request once SKU equivalence is confirmed.
- HelioMed procurement: please confirm whether they will issue a PO (invoice flow) or prefer marketplace billing; cc’d procurement@heliomed.com to confirm.
- DocuSign envelope for the Partner Registration is ready: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-GCP-HELIOMED

Proposed sync: Thu 12/2 10:00 AM PT — 30 minutes to confirm SKU mapping and co-sell tags. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this looks ready for partner-ops review.

Best,
Maria

Maria Torres
Partner Ecosystem, GCP Marketplace
Google Cloud Partners
